mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id INNER JOIN sys_menu m ON rm.menu_id = m.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND m.status = 1 AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms <> ''
SELECT DISTINCT r.role_code FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 AND r.is_deleted = 0
